lines.**第一階段：完成 Token 成本試算。** 我先把流程拆成兩段：地端用兩組: **Phase 1: the token cost estimate.** I split the flow in two: on premises, two OCR models read the documents and an SLM checks inconsistencies; a cloud LLM processes the results. OCR work is measured in pages, not tokens: a dense table page and a one-line title differ ten times in tokens but take similar scan time. In the cloud, each case uses 11,250 input and 2,500 output tokens. With a GPT5.5 price assumption ($2.5 input / $15 output), that is about NT$1.92 per case. Multiplied by the growing volume (14,999, 16,649, and 18,480 cases per month in years 1 to 3), it gives the 3-year token cost.

So STT is measured in minutes and the SLM in tokens, multiplied separately and then added. From 43,000 calls per month, I placed the workload in the business-hour peak: it must answer in real time and cannot move to off-peak like a batch job.

RAG separates the knowledge base from the model: when a document changes, only its embeddings are rebuilt. I compared Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, and Qdrant, and chose Qdrant: it runs self-hosted on Docker so data stays inside the company, it supports filtering for category queries, and it performs well at medium data volume.

Space is GPU memory: it holds models, is never given back, and is a fixed cost. Time is GPU compute: it runs requests, is reused, and is a variable cost. The bank's pool is 5 RTX PRO 6000 cards at 96 GB each: 480 GB and 432,000 card-seconds per day.

The in-sample period is from February 1, 2020, to December 31, 2022, and the out-of-sample period is from January 1, 2023, to December 30, 2024, with 2025 to be considered next. strings.：判斷適用哪些法規，和業務單位一起訂出 AI 的紅線，決定風險等級。: : Determine which regulations apply, work with business units to establish AI red lines, and decide on risk levels.
strings.：協調模型選型、提示詞與檢索的技術決策，追蹤每一輪測試的結果。: : Coordinate technical decisions regarding model selection, prompts, and retrieval, and track the results of each round of testing.
strings.：協調跨團隊的技術決策，例如平台選型、效能與技術風險。: : Coordinate cross-team technical decisions, such as platform selection, performance, and technical risks.
strings.：參與 UAT，確認功能符合需求，簽核驗收。: : Participate in UAT, confirm that the features meet the requirements, and approve acceptance.
strings.：取代傳統的 QA。傳統測試是「輸入 A 一定得到 B」，AI 要用評測集衡量準: : Replacing traditional QA. Traditional testing follows the principle of "input A must yield B." In contrast, AI uses evaluation sets to assess accuracy, consistency, and the rationale behind its judgments.
strings.：在多個 AI 專案之間排優先順序。成本效益基準是它分配資源的依據。: : Prioritize among multiple AI projects. The cost-benefit benchmark serves as the basis for its resource allocation.
strings.：定義產品藍圖，排定需求的優先順序。: : Define the product roadmap and prioritize requirements.
strings.：客戶，以及和 AI 一起工作的徵審、客服人員。他們的使用紀錄與回饋，是改善的起: : Customers, as well as underwriting and customer service personnel who work with AI. Their usage records and feedback serve as the starting point for improvement.
strings.：寫系統規格：資料流、API 介面、和既有系統怎麼接。: : Write system specifications: data flow, APIs, and how to connect with existing systems.
strings.：彙整各專案的成效，比較實際值和基準，決定資源要加碼還是調整。: : Consolidate the performance of each project, compare the actual values with the benchmarks, and decide whether to increase or adjust resources.
strings.：把實際的業務量、成本與效益，和上線前的基準比較，算出實現率。: : Compare the actual business volume, costs, and benefits with the pre-launch baseline to calculate the achievement rate.
strings.：把業務需求翻成 AI 可以做的任務：拆解流程、定義輸入與輸出、寫下邊界與驗收標: : Translate business requirements into tasks that AI can perform: break down processes, define inputs and outputs, and document boundaries and acceptance criteria.
strings.：把規範變成可以測試的題目與系統控制。: : Transform specifications into testable items and system controls.
strings.：把驗收標準寫成測題。業務情境的題目，和已知答案的歷史案例。: : Formulate acceptance criteria as test questions. Questions based on business scenarios and historical cases with known answers.
strings.：持續監控風險，定期檢視是否仍符合規範。: : Continuously monitor risks and regularly review whether they still comply with regulations.
strings.：推廣使用，回報業務成效，提出下一輪的需求。: : Promote usage, report on business performance, and propose requirements for the next round.
strings.：提供真實的業務情境與案例，判斷答案在業務上是否正確。: : Provide real-world business scenarios and cases to determine whether the answers are correct in a business context.
strings.：提出需求與場景，定義成功的樣子（例如轉換率、處理率），提供業務量。AI 的價值: : Present requirements and scenarios, define what success looks like (e.g., conversion rate, processing rate), and provide business volume. Ultimately, the value of AI must be recognized by the business unit.
strings.：整合測試之外，每次改動都重跑評測集，確認回答沒有變差。: : In addition to integration testing, the evaluation set is rerun for every change to ensure that the quality of the answers has not deteriorated.
strings.：核准風險較高的 AI 上線。: : Approve the launch of AI with higher risk.
strings.：檢查存取控制、資料隔離與上線前的資安意見。: : Review access control, data isolation, and pre-launch security recommendations.
strings.：準備算力、網路與環境，依業務量規劃容量。: : Prepare computing power, network, and environment, and plan capacity based on business volume.
strings.：獨立檢查整個流程有沒有照規範走。: : Conduct an independent inspection to determine whether the entire process complies with regulations.
strings.：用「業務量 × 單件用量 × 單價」建立成本與效益的基準，上線後拿來算實現率。: : Establish a baseline for costs and benefits using "business volume × usage per unit × unit price," and use it to calculate the realization rate after going live.
strings.：監控服務、處理事件、維護環境。: : Monitoring services, handling incidents, and maintaining the environment.
strings.：監看算力用量，必要時擴充或重新配置。: : Monitor computing power usage and expand or reallocate as needed.
strings.：盤點所有 AI 應用，確認分級，初審檢核結果。: : Take stock of all AI applications, confirm their classification, and review the initial assessment results.
strings.：確認資料分級，以及哪些資料可以送到外部模型。: : Confirm the data classification and which data can be sent to external models.
strings.：確認輸出不違反法規，例如投資建議的用語、授信的公平性。: : Confirm that the output does not violate regulations, such as the terminology used in investment advice and the fairness of credit extensions.
strings.：管時程、範圍、廠商與驗收，訂出啟動、需求、UAT、上線的里程碑。: : Manage the schedule, scope, vendors, and acceptance, and set milestones for initiation, requirements, UAT, and go-live.
strings.：解讀法規，訂風險分級，對每個 AI 出具意見。: : Interpret regulations, establish risk classifications, and provide opinions on each AI system.
strings.：訂年度策略與 KPI，核准預算上限。: : Set annual strategies and KPIs, and approve budget limits.
strings.：設計介面與對話體驗，例如 AI 回答要怎麼呈現、什麼時候顯示轉人工。: : Design interfaces and conversational experiences, such as how AI responses should be presented and when to escalate to a human agent.
strings.：設計攻擊題與紅隊測試，確認個資與機密不會外洩。: : Design attack scenarios and red team tests to ensure that personal data and confidential information are not leaked.
strings.：調提示詞、設計 RAG 的檢索方式、選模型，必要時微調。: : Adjust prompts, design RAG retrieval methods, select models, and fine-tune them when necessary.
strings.：資料來源、清理、標註與品質。: : Data sources, cleaning, labeling, and quality.
strings.：資料保護、存取控制、模型攻擊的防護。: : Data protection, access control, and protection against model attacks.
strings.：追蹤進度與資源，確認專案照計畫推進。: : Track progress and resources to ensure the project is progressing as planned.
strings.：開發功能、寫單元測試。: : Develop features and write unit tests.
strings.：除了監控服務是否正常，還要監控回答品質、模型退化與 Token 成本。: : In addition to monitoring whether the service is functioning normally, it is also necessary to monitor the quality of responses, model degradation, and token costs.
